items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: That was when I first met Basie.

ctx.x: Gonzell White. Now those two names may not be the other two musicians that were with him, but there were two trumpet players and Basie. That was when I first met Basie. That was back in 1925 or 1926.
Before he even came to Kansas City.
